hero.title: Nationwide reach, global delivery
hero.description: Redefining the map of fire training towers across China and the world. Our training facilities are the solid foundation of department readiness.

overviewSection.title: Leading the evolution of fire training towers
overviewSection.description: With 1000+ training complex projects, TZJ products are recognized for durability, effectiveness, and safety. Our impact goes beyond numbers — it reflects an relentless pursuit of excellence and innovation.

sectorsSection.title: Training solutions for teams across industries
sectorsSection.description: From municipal fire departments to mining, education, and tourism — TZJ builds training facilities tailored to each sector's emergency response needs.

highlights.title: Standard Tower Series
highlights.desc: Industry-changing steel fixed towers — dual-frame design with all-galvanized walls, guardrails, stairs, and ladders. Fast standard delivery, deep customization, and future expansion.

highlights.title: Interlocking Thermal Liner
highlights.desc: Evolving calcium silicate liner system delivering the best balance of durability and thermal protection for modern burn rooms.

highlights.title: Modular Training System
highlights.desc: Unlike other modular approaches — all-galvanized steel frames with open floor plans and reconfigurable walls, doors, and windows.

highlights.title: Hazmat Training Props
highlights.desc: A dozen hazmat props and mobile trailers replicating real hazard scenarios for cross-regional coordinated training.

quote.text: We are committed to delivering turnkey training solutions for fire departments across China and overseas — with ongoing support long after delivery.
